NIS2, DORA, AI Act e Cyber Resilience Act chiedono prove, controlli e una governance capace di fermare decisioni ad alto impatto nelle infrastrutture più esposte L'articolo AI nella cyberdefense, perché la fiducia passa dalla verifica proviene da Agenda Digitale .

title: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
summary: Now exiting stealth mode with a $26 million seed round, Keenable has been building a vast web search index for AI agents.

title: AI Safety Startup Alice, Partner of Google, Anthropic, Raises $140 Million
summary: An Israeli startup that works to protect artificial intelligence models from misuse and rogue behavior has raised $140 million after a spate of high-profile hacks from AI systems.
